==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Utilizing the self induced sleep paralysis method, I become lucid. I immediately travel to Aegis the Island of Heroes. It is a floating, Greek, space island.
I press a secret button on a stage and become the king. Now everyone wants the button.

I create a magical woman to defend the button from the other dreamers on the island. She has pale skin, straight black hair, and wears black leather. Her otherworldly beauty is her weapon.
